title: Refine setup metadata without contradiction
description: Allow explicit unknown setup identity fields to gain non-contradictory known detail while retaining provenance and the previous unknown state in history.
acceptanceCriteria: An unknown field can be refined to a known value through an explicit action
Refinement records prior state, new value, source/provenance, and timestamp
An unchanged known value may gain provenance without creating a contradiction
Refinement does not assert compatibility, calibration, suitability, or automatic verification

steps.details: Add a pure comparison that classifies proposed metadata as unchanged, unknown-to-known refinement, or known contradiction per field.
Persist accepted refinement events or revisions so the previous unknown state and disclosed source remain inspectable after reload.
Add a keyboard-operable refinement action that previews changed fields and states that compatibility is not inferred.
Cover unknown-to-known, same-known provenance, multi-field refinement, reload, and rejected contradictory input with focused tests.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; add only refinement classification, provenance, and focused coverage.
Unknown is not a wildcard and refinement is not proof that two physical conditions are the same.
Contradictory known changes are handled by TASK-64.
